## Duplicate 'if' condition This condition is a duplicate of value === 'first'. --- To fix duplicate conditions in an if/else if chain, ensure each condition is unique or remove unreachable duplicate branches.
In this specific file (tools/quality-language/acceptance-fixture.js), the best non-speculative fix is to delete the duplicate else if (value === 'first') return 'two'; line. This avoids inventing an unverified condition and preserves clear behavior: 'first' maps to 'one', everything else maps to 'other'.

No new imports, methods, or definitions are needed.
